reason: This plugin bundle’s user-facing role is integrating MCP Apps into DeepSeek Harness by supplying an MCP host service plus a web renderer so MCP App outputs can be displayed as UI surfaces in the DSH web client, while keeping app execution via AppBridge in a browser-rendered path.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 MCP Apps 的主机能力与 Web 渲染器，可将 `ui://` 与 `text/html;profile=mcp-app` 的 MCP App 结果在内嵌、全屏或画中画界面中展示。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle that provides MCP App host support and a web renderer to display MCP App results in inline, fullscreen, or picture-in-picture interfaces.

capabilities: Adds DSH plugin rows for MCP Apps host and web renderer
Renders MCP App tool results in browser UI using AppBridge
Supports inline/fullscreen/picture-in-picture display modes for MCP App sessions
Bridges callTool/readResource flow from MCP client through host-remote boundary

reasons.code: README describes this project as a DSH MCP Apps host and renderer bundle with a Cordis patch adding Host and Web plugin rows.
README specifies only rendered results matching mcp-app card + ui:// URI + MIME text/html;profile=mcp-app are claimed via tool.call.takeover.
README details loading App HTML through a double-iframe boundary with CSP and origin checks for relay messages before rendering.
package.json declares this as a bundle package with workspace dependencies on @openma/dsh-mcp-apps-host and @openma/dsh-mcp-apps-web.
